## attendance_days

One derived row per staff per IST calendar day. status_source gates whether recompute_attendance_day() may rewrite status, so a manual override, approved leave, holiday or week-off is never silently undone by a later punch or the nightly scan.

## attendance_networks

Owner-managed office-IP allowlist for self-service punching. Enforcement is gated by the custom_options attendance_settings toggle and fails OPEN when no active row exists, so an empty list can never lock the team out. A deterrent against casual off-site punching, not a tamper-proof boundary -- see docs/bible/processes/configure-office-punch-networks.md.

## attendance_punches

Append-only punch-event log. A correction is a new row plus a void on the old one; rows are never edited or deleted. attendance_days is derived from this by recompute_attendance_day() -- the sale_payments/sync_sale_payment_totals pattern.

Populated by scripts/bible/sync.ts from each process chapter's frontmatter `module:` field. Deliberately not a foreign key: scripts/bible/sync.ts upserts modules and processes independently, one file at a time, with no ordering guarantee on a first sync against an empty table -- a FK could reject a valid process row upserted before its module row exists. Referential validity is instead checked in application code at the end of sync.ts, which fails loudly on a bad reference rather than being silently wrong. |

## rental_agreement_items

One physical serialized unit out on one rental. Scoped to serialized categories (LAP/DES/MON/TAB) -- fungible accessories have no asset_ledger row and are out of scope. This is where the unit<->rental link lives: a rent-charge `sales` row deliberately leaves asset_ledger_id NULL so the unit never reads as sold and its purchase cost is never charged as COGS against one month of rent.

## rental_agreements

One rental deal: a customer takes N units from ordinary sellable stock for a period. Rent is billed per billing_interval into real `sales` rows (sales.rental_agreement_id) -- there is no separate rental revenue ledger. Overdue is NEVER stored: it is derived from expected_return_date vs an item still on_rent. overdue_notified_at / billing_notified_at are cron dedup markers only, not status.
